name: duel-1
title: The duel, phase 1 (Move): two virtual players' first duel, free in the world and seen as a player sees it (the duel's own camera: third person behind seat 1, framing both), the HUD on screen; in the temple, then a few seconds locked to the stage plane to show the option, then the forge. Each shot is the duel from its first frame (the count-in, then play), the brains seeded, deterministic.

shots.note: the temple's court (the fallback arena: the stage's middle, 7.5 m round, the altar and the stumps to jump onto, the pillars to go round and kick off): fire, showy (wall kicks, flips, aús), against water, aggressive; free from the count-in, then at 11 s the lock (the stage plane through the court) for the last five seconds
the sky forge's anvil over the pit (no floor round it: a fall is a KO), free: water, evasive, against fire, aggressive
